modelDescription: Where people, tools, and records stop agreeing.
title: Start with the operation, not the feature list.
description: I look for repeated handoffs, invisible state, and the moment someone stops trusting the record.
example: Recurring donor work split between spreadsheets and WhatsApp became the starting point for Hibah.

modelDescription: Entities, state, boundaries, and failure cases.
title: Turn the messy parts into explicit boundaries.
description: Domain models, permissions, state transitions, and failure modes should make the system easier to explain.
example: PumpOS anchors shifts, stock, credit, and reporting to one business-day record.

modelDescription: APIs, data, interfaces, and operational feedback.
title: Choose tools for the constraint in front of them.
description: Go for focused backend services, Flutter for cross-platform products, TypeScript for web systems, Swift for native tools.
example: tqwp explores a small Go API for concurrent work and configurable retries.

modelDescription: Then learn from what the system meets in reality.
title: Own the path until a person can use it.
description: Backend quality matters most when it survives contact with product behavior, deployment, and everyday use.
example: My work includes live products, public repositories, and an extension submitted to Raycast.
